basis: Andrew, 22 Oct 2026: "never came to site 1276701"; "remove the 1276701 350A". GN20 (S01, the 365 kVA set 1276701 on Baseplan 9961976 line 6, to be delivered as a 350 kVA) never arrived. The record had GN20 on site and complete since 29-30 Sep. Through the page's own controls, as an editor would: Complete off, the light to not on site, and a note saying why. Nothing else changes.

ops.text: Never came to site: the 365 kVA set 1276701 on contract 9961976 line 6 was not delivered (Andrew Fisher, 22 Oct 2026). Nothing to charge on GN20.
